summary: Full MVP readiness audit of Loop marketplace (Need + Provide friction-reduction batch). Backend: 37/37 pytest cases pass across auth (OTP + faculty + brute-force 429 lockout + logout), verification gate (unverified 403 on hire/rent/apply/request/provide, approve unlocks), search/matching (PPT ranks Priya first, drone returns no_match), full SERVICE state machine + review + reputation update, full RESOURCE state machine + deposit refund, FCFS apply/select creating hire tx, request lifecycle renew/cancel with 403 on other users, NL intent parsing (need/provide, category, days, location, missing flags), /provides listings + reverse-discovery notified counts + gate, /opportunities + /suggestions, in-context messaging with canned auto-reply for seeded refs and thread-on-tx, inline rating gated to COMPLETED, session + request persistence. Frontend E2E on the preview URL runs the entire primary journey: 5-step onboarding (email -> OTP 123456 -> Profile -> Verify -> Personalize All three -> Enter Loop), reload preserves session, Need composer parses 'drafter 3 days Civil Block' -> Physical Resource / 3 / Civil Block, unverified POST /api/requests correctly returns 403 (only non-2xx besides pre-login /auth/me), Profile 'Approve (demo)' flips to Verified and unlocks transacting, posting Need renders 6 match cards, Provide composer parses PPT design -> Presentation and lists + notifies, Explore search 'Engineering Mechanics PPT' ranks provider-priya first, 'drone' shows no-match empty state, full hire flow accept -> pay (contact revealed) -> complete -> confirm -> 5-star rate, FCFS Offer on req-seed-2 works, MessageDrawer opens on tx-message, message send + canned auto-reply persists (4 messages), Insights loads, mobile 390px composer visible via mobile-nav, logout returns to onboarding welcome, and a full rental flow reserve -> accept -> pay -> pickup -> return -> confirm_return shows deposit refunded banner. No console errors beyond expected pre-login /auth/me 401 and the expected 403 gate.
critical_code_review_comments: OTP_CHALLENGES + rate-limit state is in-process memory. Single-worker uvicorn is fine for demo but a multi-worker deploy would allow brute-force bypass (each worker resets the counter). Move to Redis or a DB collection with TTL before scaling.
backend/.env CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid in browsers; the allow_origin_regex saves the preview URL but the '*' entry should be removed for correctness.

match_score for /requests/{id}/apply builds signal from user.personalization ['need','skill','resource'] which never contains real skill tokens, so applicant match% floors at 55 (max(55,30)). Consider deriving skill signal from user's provide listings or profile skill tags.
server.py is 447 lines and mixes auth/storage/marketplace/tx/reviews/messaging. Acceptable for MVP but the next feature batch should split into routers.
In-memory _storage_key with force=True re-init only on 404 is fine, but a 401/403 from the object store won't trigger re-init. Consider retrying re-init on any auth-class error.
match_score threshold >=50 for services in /requests create is a soft floor - shows only high-quality matches, which is intentional; document this.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - full primary journey (Need + Provide + Hire + Rent + FCFS + Messaging + Reload + Logout) green
